name: review-toolkit
description: Three review skills. pr-review drafts a PR review: the reviewer judges the change from the diff and the tree before the author's description, a doubt or a mechanical sign in the diff becomes a five-line card for the owner instead of a blocker, a second model joins the code pass and every finding is checked against the sources, and only a path shown through the sources to a wrong result, a quoted item the project wrote down, or a behaviour change without a test that fails without it, at the layer that owns the behaviour, blocks; publishing is opt-in and an LGTM goes out as APPROVE only when the PR can merge now. series-review reads the merged changes to one subsystem together and gives the owner one page on what it has become and what could be removed. branch-review reviews a branch with merge-base attribution, so only defects the diff introduced, worsened, or interacts with decide the verdict.
